metadata.name: perf-long-session
metadata.description: Operator-authorized real-data performance journey: heartbeat investigation with hundreds of events; scroll, open a long reply, find in reply, session search, and restore the previous pane/view. No session creation, terminal input, send, archive, deletion, or conversation control. May advance the seen cursor. Never bind as requirement automation. Prefer the supported ?session=<existing-id> deep link when the shared active pane or sidebar visibility differs.

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{const el=document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-scroll"]');let maxNodes=0;performance.mark('long-session:scroll:start');for(const direction of [-1,1]){for(let i=0;i<45;i++){el.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel',{bubbles:true,deltaY:direction*240}));el.scrollTop+=direction*240;await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));maxNodes=Math.max(maxNodes,el.querySelectorAll('*').length);}}performance.mark('long-session:scroll:end');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));return {maxNodes,top:el.scrollTop,rows:el.querySelectorAll('[data-event-id]').length};})()

(async()=>{let buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="msg-open-reader-"]')];const button=buttons.sort((a,b)=>b.closest('[data-event-id]').textContent.length-a.closest('[data-event-id]').textContent.length)[0];if(!button)throw new Error('No long message in captured window');performance.mark('long-session:reader:start');button.click();const reader=await window.__longSessionWait(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="reader-scroll"]'));for(let i=0;i<15;i++){reader.scrollTop+=180;await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));}const input=document.querySelector('[data-testid="reader-find-input"]');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;for(const value of ['a','au','auth','authentication']){set.call(input,value);input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const chars=document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-reader-body"]').textContent.length;document.querySelector('[data-testid="reader-back"]').click();performance.mark('long-session:reader:end');return {chars};})()

(async()=>{(await window.__longSessionWait(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-search-field"]'))).click();const input=await window.__longSessionWait(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="msg-nav-search"]'));const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;performance.mark('long-session:search:start');for(const value of ['h','he','hea','heart','heartbeat']){set.call(input,value);input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));set.call(input,'');input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true}));performance.mark('long-session:search:end');return {closed:!document.querySelector('[data-testid="msg-nav-search"]')};})()

(async()=>{if(innerWidth>=768)return {mobile:false};const input=await window.__longSessionWait(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="mobile-command-input"]'));const original=input.value;const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(input.tagName==='TEXTAREA'?HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;performance.mark('long-session:draft:start');input.focus();const draft='Unsent performance audit draft: checking long-session typing without sending.';for(let i=1;i<=draft.length;i++){set.call(input,draft.slice(0,i));input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));}set.call(input,original);input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));input.blur();performance.mark('long-session:draft:end');return {mobile:true,characters:draft.length,restored:input.value===original};})()

metadata.label: Type and restore an unsent draft on mobile; never press Enter or Submit
